complete.description: false if the review could not cover the whole change (tool failure, context limit, missing files). Incomplete reviews block.

summary.description: Starts with a count, e.g. '2 important, 1 nit.' or '0 findings: nothing to fix.'

failure_scenario.description: Concrete trigger -> wrong outcome. No scenario, no finding.

evidence.description: file:line citations (or command output) that prove the claim. Names alone are not evidence.

bug_class.description: The general pattern, so the author can fix every instance, e.g. 'unscoped tenant query'.
